_reference.english: Poison, Disease, and Stun a random enemy.

sourceEvidence.note: troop 6229 Sand Cobra: spell 7371 "Poison, Disease, and Stun a random enemy.", cost 6 Brown.
spell 7371 Target None: CauseDisease RandomEnemy; CausePoison FromPrevious; CauseStun FromPrevious.
Official status guide: status semantics (Barrier, Silence, Stun, Disease, Death Mark, Enrage, Submerged, cumulative cleanse chance via Cursed/Lycanthropy entries).
troop:6229: real TurnEngine.castSkill both sides + boundaries

R004: negatives no turn cap, shared cumulative self-cleanse 10%/+10% (+5% Cursed), Poison never; positives end on trigger (Barrier/Reflect damage, Enchanted cast, Enraged skull damage, Submerged/Blessed holder action).
Round-3 real castSkill both sides: statuses from this cast unchanged after 6 failed turn-start rolls; one successful roll removes all recoverable negatives together (Poison/positives stay).
Saved community corroboration for R004 (staff reply: new negative resets, all negatives cleanse together).
R001: native SpellSteps order governs observable order.

target-count-range.note: One random living enemy (varies over 30 seeds; dead never picked).

status-duration-immunity.note: Disease/Stun R004: no turn cap; persists through 6 failed turn-start rolls, removed by one successful shared self-cleanse roll (gowLaneL5R3). Poison never self-cleanses; Disease-immune blocks Disease; Invulnerable blocks all.

order-death-retargeting.note: Disease -> Poison -> Stun native order (R001); Stun last cannot strip immunity first.

mana-economy-extra-turn.note: Cast spends full mana and passes the turn; low mana and Silence block the real cast (no mana/action spent).

display-description.note: Chinese description asserted verbatim; wording matches the English effect.

battle-pipeline.note: Real TurnEngine.castSkill both sides (lane file + round-3 R004 file).
